title: FREE VICTORIA'S SECRET GIFT CARDS UPDATE | 2/11/16
description: Hey guys, This video is an update to my previous VS  promo video. Victoria's Secret issued two changes to their Secret Rewards Promo, they are as follows:  1. You now need to include a self addressed stamped envelope with your 4x6 index card. VS has decided to mail your gift cards as opposed to emailing them.  2. The VS mailing address has also changed, please disregard the previous address given. The new mailing address is:  Victoria's Secret  Secret Reward Promotion P.O Box 139024 Dallas, TX 75313  Hope this helps!  If you have no idea what promo I'm referring to please see my previous video for more details.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d_1rKq34488  Smooches!

now along with your 4x6 card with your name, address, birth date, and email, you also need to include a Self-Address Stamped envelope.
They are going to actually mail them to you.

textual.context: Presented as an update to a promotional offer and as information intended to help viewers follow changed requirements; the source does not establish whether the offer or claimed affiliation is valid.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift cards are linked to mailing personally identifying information and a self-addressed stamped envelope to a stated promotion address, creating a concrete reward, data-flow and requested-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether Victoria's Secret authorized the promotion, whether the address is authentic, whether viewers received gift cards, or whether any information or payment was misused.

visual.context: The material is presented as a numbered visual process or promotional instruction; the source's purpose and whether the branding is authorized are unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised reward-card promotion is visibly linked to providing multiple personal-data fields and mailing information to a specified destination, creating a task-relevant reward-and-data-request relationship for conditional review.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as an update to a claimed Victoria’s Secret gift-card promotion and explains revised submission requirements and a replacement mailing address. The requests to share, comment, or subscribe are separate audience-engagement requests rather than stated conditions for receiving the cards.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed context is an ordinary rewards-card promotion: a stated free gift-card benefit is linked to submitting a card with specified personal details and mailing materials to a promotion address. The supplied evidence does not establish whether the promotion or address is genuine, so this classification describes the observed promotional context without certifying the external offer.
